Blended Xocai Activ Coffee Drink
By: Adam Paul Green
Published: Friday, September 9, 2011 - 5:44am

Ingredients




16 oz 	Cup of ice
1-2 cups    Milk (regular, soy, or almond)
2 tbsp 	Favorite powdered coffee mix
1 1/2 cup 	Liquid Xocai Activ
1 dash 	liquid sweetener ((to taste))
1 dash 	vanilla ((to taste))

Preparation

1 Put all ingredients in the blender and blend until smooth. 2 Feel free to experiment with different flavors of coffees, such as amaretto, hazelnut or cinnamon. 3 Serves 2

About

Kick start your morning Coffee. Coffee married with delicious "Xocai Activ Chocolate" will get you going in the morning!
